address_evidence.evidence_note: Third-party data-center listings publish 600 Britain Dr; Storey County assessment rolls confirm PowerHouse Reno Britain LLC on parcels 005-041-66 and 005-041-67 but do not expose a project-specific building-permit record in the reviewed public search.

status_as_of_cutoff: site work-construction as of 2026-08-11. PowerHouse's current Reno project page lists construction/delivery from Q3 2024 to Q2 2026 and power delivery in Q4 2025; DCD/PowerHouse reporting described a fall 2024 groundbreaking and work on the first building. Storey County's 2026-27 secured assessment roll confirms PowerHouse Reno Britain LLC on two TRIC-area parcels, but no project-specific Storey County permit, certificate of occupancy, service-date, or energization record was located in the reviewed public surfaces.

actions.government_body: Nevada State Library and Archives / state publication
actions.result_status: The Nevada public report described a 900,000-square-foot PowerHouse shell campus in TRIC. It is a state publication, but not a permit or certificate of completion.
actions.access_caveat: The report is a broad state publication and does not publish a Storey permit number or service date.
actions.evidence_note: Government publication; project-stage evidence is descriptive.

actions.result_status: No project-specific Storey County land-use/building permit, inspection/CO, NV Energy interconnection, energization, or first-service record was located.
actions.access_caveat: County and utility public surfaces do not expose a matching record in the reviewed search.

actions.government_body: Storey County Assessor / secured assessment roll
actions.result_status: The 2026-27 secured assessment roll lists PowerHouse Reno Britain LLC on parcels 005-041-66 and 005-041-67 in district 122, with land values but no building value shown for either parcel.
actions.access_caveat: Assessment-roll evidence confirms assessed owner and parcels, not permit status or energization.
actions.evidence_note: Official county source; property/parcel evidence only.

actions.result_status: PowerHouse's current Reno project page lists a 49-acre, up-to-3-building, 900,000-SF campus with 200 MW of power, April 2026 delivery, construction/delivery Q3 2024-Q2 2026, and power delivery Q4 2025.
actions.access_caveat: Developer page does not publish a Storey County permit number, certificate of occupancy, or energization record.
actions.evidence_note: Owner/developer project-page evidence; supports construction-stage classification but not public-agency permit validation.

actions.government_body: PowerHouse Data Centers / DCD-republished company news
actions.result_status: PowerHouse/DCD reporting says the company broke ground at the 65 MW campus and started work on the first of three buildings at Tahoe Reno Industrial Center in Storey County.
actions.access_caveat: The page is company/DCD reporting and not a county permit record.

capacity_history.note: Initial company release described more than 65 MW of bridging power scheduled by year-end 2025.
Groundbreaking coverage called it a 65 MW campus and expected the first building by Q3 2025.
NAIOP/GBI case study listed 65 MW bridging power in Q1 2026 and 300 MW permanent power total.
Current PowerHouse Reno project page lists Power: 200 MW.

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; seed merged only with explicit evidence

contradictions.details: Public sources describe different power figures: initial company release and groundbreaking coverage use more than/around 65 MW, a NAIOP/GBI case study lists 65 MW bridging and 300 MW permanent power total, while the current PowerHouse Reno project page lists 200 MW. The refresh stores 200 MW as the current developer-page value and preserves the earlier values in capacity_history.

Storey County assessment-roll evidence confirms PowerHouse Reno Britain LLC parcels, and developer sources support construction-stage status, but reviewed public Storey County/ONE/NV Energy surfaces did not yield a project-specific permit number, certificate of occupancy, utility first-service date, or energization record.
